original_hour.label_zh: 冻结案例：小时单位假设

protocol.primary: Frozen input workbook, assumed hours. F/R/V paired differences vs both baselines; Holm adjustment across six tests.
protocol.seeds: Prespecified, no search for winning seeds; all runs retained.
protocol.budget: 10000 exact model calls including initialization and phase-boundary reevaluation; 200 blocks of 50, not 200 operator selections.
protocol.stage1: independent: maintenance health/cost, missions reward/flight; full mode additionally controls objective mismatch.
protocol.health: Original linear utilities and denominator, no artificial health floor; report all five final state probabilities.
protocol.units: Hours are an unverified interpretation, seconds a saturation sensitivity, 10-fold scales a hypothetical slower-degradation sensitivity.
protocol.ablation: Full vs base operator sets, on identical input, seeds, objective and budget.
protocol.claim_scope: Target-designed synthetic case; development seeds 7100-7103. Validation uses 8100-8119 after freezing. Gains are instance-specific, with no universal or engineering claim.
